From 0d0f1314e8f86f5205f71f9e31e272a1d008e40b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Qu Wenruo <wqu@suse.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 16:24:04 +1030
Subject: [PATCH] btrfs: zlib: fix the folio leak on S390 hardware acceleration

[BUG]
After commit aa60fe12b4f4 ("btrfs: zlib: refactor S390x HW acceleration
buffer preparation"), we no longer release the folio of the page cache
of folio returned by btrfs_compress_filemap_get_folio() for S390
hardware acceleration path.

[CAUSE]
Before that commit, we call kumap_local() and folio_put() after handling
each folio.

Although the timing is not ideal (it release previous folio at the
beginning of the loop, and rely on some extra cleanup out of the loop),
it at least handles the folio release correctly.

Meanwhile the refactored code is easier to read, it lacks the call to
release the filemap folio.

[FIX]
Add the missing folio_put() for copy_data_into_buffer().

CC: linux-s390@vger.kernel.org # 6.18+
Fixes: aa60fe12b4f4 ("btrfs: zlib: refactor S390x HW acceleration buffer preparation")
Reviewed-by: Boris Burkov <boris@bur.io>
Signed-off-by: Qu Wenruo <wqu@suse.com>
Reviewed-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>
Signed-off-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>

diff --git a/fs/btrfs/zlib.c b/fs/btrfs/zlib.c
index 6caba8be7c84..10ed48d4a846 100644
--- a/fs/btrfs/zlib.c
+++ b/fs/btrfs/zlib.c
@@ -139,6 +139,7 @@ static int copy_data_into_buffer(struct address_space *mapping,
 		data_in = kmap_local_folio(folio, offset);
 		memcpy(workspace->buf + cur - filepos, data_in, copy_length);
 		kunmap_local(data_in);
+		folio_put(folio);
 		cur += copy_length;
 	}
 	return 0;
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File: `fs/btrfs/zlib.c`

- **Added** a call to `folio_put(folio);` inside the loop in the function `copy_data_into_buffer()`.  
  This line is placed after `kunmap_local(data_in);`, ensuring that the filemap folio (obtained via `btrfs_compress_filemap_get_folio()`) is released after its data has been copied into the workspace buffer.

### Relationship Between Modifications

The single addition is the missing tile in the folio lifecycle. The refactoring in commit `aa60fe12b4f4` restructured the S390 hardware acceleration buffer preparation but inadvertently removed the `folio_put()` that was previously performed. This patch restores that release, preventing a folio leak. The placement is critical: the folio is put immediately after the local mapping is undone and before the loop iterates to the next folio (or before the function returns). This ensures that every folio used in the loop is properly released, closing the leak.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
<text>ret = btrfs_compress_filemap_get_folio(mapping, cur, &folio);</text>
<text>data_in = kmap_local_folio(folio, offset);</text>
<text>kunmap_local(data_in);</text>
Reason:
After the call to `btrfs_compress_filemap_get_folio()`, the folio’s reference count is incremented. Subsequent operations (`kmap_local_folio`, `memcpy`, `kunmap_local`) do not release that reference. The missing `folio_put(folio)` causes the folio to never be freed, resulting in a folio leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
<text>folio_put(folio);</text>
Reason:
Adding `folio_put(folio)` after `kunmap_local(data_in)` releases the reference obtained by `btrfs_compress_filemap_get_folio()`, ensuring the folio is properly freed and preventing the memory leak.
